create_integer: create a random integer with specified entropy, signed flag, minimum absolute value, and coprime constraint
create_non_integer_rational: create a non-integer rational number with entropy split between numerator and denominator
create_non_integer_decimal: create a non-integer decimal as an integer divided by a random power of ten
calculate_entropy_of_value: calculate the minimum entropy required to produce a given integer, rational, or decimal value
test_is_integer: test whether a value is an integer, positive integer, rational, decimal, or non-integer rational
